dog.description_text:
Simba new flyer

🦁❤️ SIMBA IS READY TO FIND HIS FOREVER KINGDOM! ❤️🦁
Okay, seriously… how has someone not scooped up this sweet boy yet?!
Simba is an adorable 3-month-old Terrier mix—and exactly what he's mixed with remains one of life's great mysteries. 😂🐾 But whatever went into the recipe, it created one VERY sweet puppy.
And this little guy is already making his foster family proud!
🚽 Doing SUPER well with house training! ⭐️
🐕 Great with other dogs
👧 Great with children
💕 Very sweet and loving
dog.name: Simba new flyer
